name: Onmyoji: Beyond Time
source:
When you were a child, the death of your mother closed the door on a supernatural world that few are able to see. Now in your final year of university, your father’s death wrenches that door open again, awakening strong spiritual powers that have long been dormant in you.

Accosted by a powerful and captivating yokai, you resort to the only spell that you know, with unexpected results. With your fates now bound together, you have to find a way to set aside your differences as you confront your heritage in the face of a darkness that looms over your childhood home.

Whether it’s family history or magic spells, you’re about to find that breaking ties is easier said than done!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.onmyoji]Google Play[/url]]
